It looks like a neighborhood doing what neighborhoods do: people carrying groceries, a grandmother walking slow with a grandkid, the bus pulling up on time. That's the story I want to chase. plan.focus: The gap between Chinatown's 133 sick residents and the single named resident on the record — what the care trail looks like from the neighborhood with the highest illness count to the hospital beds that hold six of its residents.
plan.why: The numbers tell a story the names don't. Chinatown leads the city in sick residents but has no tracked residents in care — all six beds are filled by 'other residents.' The only Chinatown name on the record is Coen Cartier, who prioritized their health after a scare. That's a human thread into a clinical gap.
